info.name: DealFlow360 API v1.0.0
info.description:
Quote-to-cash backend. Staff routes use bearer auth; customer portal routes issue a separate token type that staff routes reject.

Generated from the OpenAPI spec by `npm run postman` — edit the route JSDoc, not this file.

Run "Staff login" first: it stores accessToken, which every secured request sends automatically. Ids captured from create and list responses (productId, priceListId, userId, variantId) feed the path variables of later requests.

All responses are wrapped as { success, message, data, pagination? }.

request.description: List discount tiers, paginated

Create a discount tier (admin)

tierName is stored lowercase so quotation risk scoring can look the tier up by the customer tier.

Partially update a discount tier (admin)

Send only changed fields; at least one is required.

Delete a discount tier (admin)

Hard delete. Tiers are resolved by name at scoring time rather than referenced by id, so no records are left dangling.

Replace the category-specific discount limits (admin)

A category limit may deliberately exceed the tier maxDiscountPercent, so the two are not cross-checked.

Replace the approval chain rules (admin)

Ranges are inclusive and must not overlap, so the rule matched for a risk score does not depend on array order.
List warehouses, paginated

Create a warehouse (admin, sales_manager)

Stock is managed through the stock endpoints, not at creation time.

Transfer stock between warehouses (admin, sales_manager)

The source is debited by a single conditional update that cannot oversell, and a failed credit returns the stock, so no transaction is required.

Partially update a warehouse (admin, sales_manager)

Send only changed fields; at least one is required.
